briefing: Market was flat to slightly up (NASDAQ +0.5%, S&P500 ~0%), not a strong risk-on day, but three candidates (SRAD, AMR, ARQT) showed full multi-signal confirmation — bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, and volume surge together. With 3 open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, filled all three at medium conviction rather than high, reflecting the tepid index-level move.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for several technical signals — like RSI in a healthy bullish range, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to line up together before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前等待多項技術指標同時出現，例如RSI處於健康的多頭區間、MACD黃金交叉、股價高於均線，以及成交量放大，而非僅憑單一訊號進場。這樣可以降低追高假突破或短暫波動的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ up a modest 0.5% and the S&P 500 roughly unchanged, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than aggressively buying or selling. Without a strong macro catalyst, price action was driven more by individual stock fundamentals and technical setups than broad sentiment. A handful of smaller names showed genuine breakout strength even as the broader market stayed muted.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納指僅微升0.5%，標普500則幾乎持平，反映投資人觀望氣氛濃厚，未見明顯加碼或減碼動作。在缺乏重大總體經濟催化劑的情況下，個股表現更多由基本面及技術面主導，而非受大盤情緒帶動。部分中小型股份即使在大盤疲弱下仍展現真正的突破力道。
